What matters most is a relentless work ethic, the ability to perform under pressure, and the drive to hit and exceed ambitious targets. Comfortable managing a pipeline, following up consistently, and staying organized in a fast-paced environment. Highly motivated, competitive, and goal-driven, with a strong work ethic. Adaptable and eager to learn technology sales, with the drive to develop into enterprise and MSP sales opportunities. Experience with CRM systems is an advantage but not required. WORKING CONDITIONS The duties described below are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of this position. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, depth perceptions, and the ability to adjust focus.

Collaborate with the sales and marketing teams to improve outreach strategies and sharing of best practices. Demonstrated comfort with high-activity outbound environments, including the ability to remain positive and professional during extensive daily phone outreach. Exceptional active listening skills, with the ability to synthesize information quickly and pivot conversations based on prospect feedback. A positive attitude and a passion for helping clients, with a strong willingness to learn and adapt. Experience with CRM software (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) is a plus. Exceptional time-management skills to balance intensive calling blocks with high-quality lead research and discovery preparation. Outstanding organizational skills and attention to detail to manage leads effectively. Ability to succeed in an evolving environment and work both independently and as part of a supportive team. title: CNM 1 Day Oncology Ward 1 WTE
description: Overview: **Post Title:** Clinical Nurse Manager 1 – Day Oncology **Post Status:** Permanent **Department:** Medical Directorate **Location:** Beaumont Hospital, Dublin 9 **Reports to:** Clinical Nurse Manager 2/3 **Salary:** Appointment will be made on Clinical Nurse Manager 1 Grade (€57,780- €68,046 LSI) at a point in line with Government pay policy. **Hours of work:** 37.5 Hrs **Closing Date:** 20/11/2026 - Please note the hospital reserves the right to close the competition early should a substantial number of applications be received & a panel may be formed for future vacancies Responsibilities: **Principal Duties and Responsibilities:** 1. ADMINISTRATION OF CHEMOTHERAPY Under the guidance of the CNM2/CNM3, the CNM1 appointed to this post will have an active role in the administration of systemic anti-cancer therapies (SACT). This will involve: 1.1 Education of patients regarding their treatment. 1.2 Ordering SACT for use on the inpatient ward in a timely and economical manner. 1.3 Assessment of patients prior to administration of SACT. 1.4 Safe administration of SACT. 1.5 Monitoring patients for effects of SACT. 1.6 Safe disposal of chemotherapy equipment and agents, as per hospital guidelines. 2. BED MANAGEMENT Assist the CNM2/CNM3 or Divisional Nurse Manager in the implementation of the bed management policy by: 2.1 Managing the utilisation of patient accommodation in terms of placement of patients. 2.2 Deciding how to organise admissions and discharges of patients to and from the wards and ensuring that such activities are carried out appropriately. 2.3 Alerting the CNM2/CNM3 to any problems which the policies/practices or decisions of medical Staff are causing in the implementation of the bed policy 3. WORK TO BE DONE AND WORKLOAD ESTIMATION 3.1 On a day to day basis in the absence of CNM2, the CNM1 will decide and allocate work to be done by staff nurses, student nurses, and health care assistant. 3.2 Ensures that a systematic method for the assessment of individual patient needs and the proper documentation of same; 3.3 Estimates workload based on patient nursing needs in agreement with the unit system policy on same; 3.4 Promotes the attainment of each patient's individual nursing care needs by allocating appropriately skilled Staff Nurses. 4. STAFFING AND MANPOWER PLANNING 4.1 Advises the CNM2/CNM3/Divisional Nurse Manager or Senior Nursing Officer on duty when staff levels fall below or are in excess of that considered to be adequate to meet variations of workload. 4.2 Arranges staff meal breaks in consultation with registered nurses. 4.3 Supports and supervises nursing staff and other support staff in carrying out their allocated responsibility to the required standard. 4.4 Monitors late attendance and unexplained absenteeism, and reports to CNM2 or in her absence the CNM3. 4.5 Assists with planning and allocating of nursing teams with appropriate staff numbers, skill mix and level of experience in such a way that will meet the clinical management workload and ensure continuity of patient care. 4.6 Assists in the preparation of weekly duty rosters. Reviews and changes the roster as necessary in the CNM2's absence. 5. PERSONNEL 5.1 Promotes, nurtures and maintains a high level of staff morale hence promoting team spirit and job satisfaction among nursing, and other staff within the Ward. 5.2 Ensures welfare and safety policies are adhered to in the Ward. 5.3 Receives visiting professionals and lay visitors to the department in the CNM2's absence. 5.4 Participates in the development of a ward orientation programme for new staff members, and assists with the implementation and evaluation of such programmes. 5.5 Ensures that all staff practice nursing within the code set for the profession by the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland 5.6 Reports to CNM2 behaviour outside acceptable limits for whatever reason (i.e. emotional upset in staff, brusqueness to patients or colleagues, undignified behaviour, absenteeism, conflict, etc.) 5.7 Investigates complaints, incidents and accidents involving all patients and staff in accordance with hospital policy. 6. EDUCATION\STAFF DEVELOPMENT 6.1 Assesses and identifies training and development needs for nursing staff within the ward; participates in setting objectives for such learning and contributes to the development of training programmes where appropriate; 6.2 Identify teaching/learning opportunities within the ward and plan to meet these needs in consultation with CNM2/CNM3 and Oncology Education Co-ordinator. 6.3 Participates in the planning, Implementing and evaluation of: i) Staff development programmes to support new clinical services; ii) Post graduate training programmes as pertinent to the ward where necessary; 6.4 Participates in clinical ward induction training of all new nursing staff ensuring that staff nurses receive sufficient theoretical and practical training to make them safe practitioners; 6.5 Ensures the agreed Hospital, specialist administrative and clinical policies and procedures are known to and understood by the staff, and are implemented; 6.6 Participates in teaching, counselling and training of student nurses and plans to meet their needs in consultation with C.P.C.'s, CNM2 and CNM3. 6.7 Acts as an effective role mode by demonstrating skilled nursing care in the clinical situation for staff and student nurses. 7. CLINICAL NURSING PRACTICE 7.1 Assists in the development and maintenance of protocols specific to the care of Oncology patients and the administration of SACT. 7.2 Uses a framework and model of nursing to assess individual patient needs consistent with hospital nursing policy; 7.3 Ensures that appropriate nursing care is planned for individual patients based on need assessment and that each individual patient receives prescribed medical treatment and nursing care, within established policies, procedures and standards of care; 7.4 Ensures that verbal and written nursing reporting systems are accurate and adequate; 7.5 Ensures that accurate nursing reports accompany patients who are being transferred to other hospitals or other departments in Beaumont Hospital. 7.6 Ensures clinical competence of staff in performing clinical activities. 7.7 Maintains personal clinical skills by performing nursing care; 7.8 Directs, supervises and mentors the nursing staff in the management of nursing care i.e. providing professional and specialist advice on the provision of nursing care and demonstrate practical nursing skills; 7.9 In consultation with medical staff ensures that patients and relatives are appropriately informed and counselled regarding their condition, short and long term treatment/care plans and that they are adequately educated, trained and rehabilitated; 7.10 Participates in research when necessary. 7.11 Attends and participates in multidisciplinary ward rounds and meetings. 8. STANDARDS AND QUALITY OF CARE Takes all steps possible to safeguard the welfare and safety of patients by: 8.1 Monitoring indicators of quality. 8.2 Monitoring ward management and clinical standards within realistic targets and explicit limits as set by CNM2. 8.3 Ensuring that ward staff understand and abide be required standards and limits. 8.4 Checking on the quality of all work done by all ward staff and use of systems in place. 8.5 Monitoring and evaluating the outcomes of nursing care for individual patients. 9. BUDGETING 9.1 Maintains agreed stock level controls and reports any deficiencies to Sister. 9.2 Encourages staff to utilise resources judiciously by developing economical habits and adhering to the limits so as to ensure economical use consistent with satisfactory standards. 10. SELF DEVELOPMENT The post holder is expected to: 10.1 Maintain, update and develop knowledge on relevant professional development and on all speciality current trends by attending a number of study days each year; 10.2 Maintain a personal record of professional development; 10.3 Accept appraisal each year from the CNM2. 10.4 Discuss present performance and future self development needs with the Divisional Nurse Manager/CNM3 and CNM2, using job performance review in accordance with unit policy. 11. WARD AUXILIARY STAFF 11.1 Ensures that the work of the Health Care Assistant is implemented to the required standard as per job specification; 11.2 Participates in the induction and training of the Health Care Assistant. 11.3 Supervises, supports and encourages the Health Care Assistant in carrying out their duties and ensures that nursing staff know, understand, utilise and respects the role. 12. ADMINISTRATIVE: WARD CLERK 12.1 Ensures the correct completion of records and reports. 12.2 Supervises, supports and encourages Ward Clerk in the implementation of their role and ensures that the nursing staff know, understand, utilise and maintain respect in the carrying out of duties and reports same to their immediate manager The job description is an outline of the post as it is currently perceived by the hospital and will be subject to review and amendment. This job description will therefore be subject to change in light of the various strategies for the hospital and the development of the Clinical Directorate model and any future developments that arise and will evolve and change over time. Qualifications: **Selection Criteria:** Selection criteria outline the qualifications, skills, knowledge and/or experience that the successful candidate would need to demonstrate for successful discharge of the responsibilities of the post. Applications will be assessed on the basis of how well candidates satisfy these criteria. **Mandatory:** * Be registered in the relevant division of the Register of Nurses kept by The Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland or be entitled to be so registered. * Have at least 3 years post registration experience of which 1 must be in the speciality or related area * Have the clinical, managerial and administrative capacity to properly discharge the functions of the role. * Have completed a recognised course in the administration of systemic anti-cancer therapies, ie chemotherapy/ immunotherapy. **Desirable:** * A management course is desirable **Informal Enquiries ONLY to:** Name: Yvonne Whelan Title: Directorate Nurse Manager Email address: yvonnewhelan@beaumont.ie Telephone: 01 8528197 If an appointee has previously been employed in the Civil or Public Service and that appointee is entitled to or in receipt of a pension from the Civil or Public Service or where a Civil/ Public Service pension comes into payment during the appointee’s re-employment that pension will be subject to abatement in accordance with Section 52 of the Public Service Pensions (Single Scheme and other Provisions) Act 2012. Please note: In applying for this position you are acknowledging that you understand that the abatement provisions, where relevant, will apply. It is not envisaged that the employing Department/ Office/ Body will support an application for an abatement waiver in respect of appointments to this position. Please be aware that Beaumont Hospital will never ask candidates to pay money at any stage of the recruitment process. Any requests for payment, bank details, or financial information in connection with a job application should be treated as fraudulent. If you receive such a request claiming to be from Beaumont Hospital, please do not respond and report to the recruitment department immediately.

title: Customer Service / Sales Administrator
description: Amicus Search & Recruitment is working with our client, an established family-owned Irish business in the agricultural sector, to hire two Customer Service / Sales Administrators for their Dublin 15 office. You’ll take in customer purchase orders and create and manage sales orders in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. You’ll work with Operations on stock availability and delivery priorities, and coordinate picking, dispatch and delivery with the company’s third-party logistics provider. You’ll be the customer’s main contact: keeping them updated on orders and delivery dates, answering everyday queries, and handling returns and complaints until they’re fully resolved. You’ll work closely with Sales, Operations and Finance to keep the order-to-delivery process running smoothly. Our client wants people who are bright, good with numbers and very accurate with data entry. You should be comfortable with Excel and Outlook and confident talking to customers. You’ll need to be organised enough to chase the warehouse when needed, and happy doing transactional work that can be repetitive. title: Graduate Sales Executive | Start Your Sales Career in 2027 | Base + Uncapped Commission
description: You spent years studying business. This is where you actually learn it. DG Ventures is building something. We need graduates who want to be part of building it, not just watching it happen. We are scaling fast. 100 new hires across multiple brands, two new floors added to our Mullingar head office, and a brand new office in South Africa. The growth is real and the opportunity is now. DG Ventures is building a group of companies across tourism, outsourcing, media, property, transport, AI, and private equity. **This is a Business Graduate Leadership Programme, not just a graduate job.** The long term vision is simple. Start in the business. Learn fast. Perform. Lead people. Understand numbers. Help grow companies. Earn the opportunity to one day run one. You may begin in a junior role across sales, business development, operations, marketing, AI implementation, or private equity support. The goal is to develop people who grow into: * Sales Lead * Business Development Manager * Operations Manager * Private Equity Analyst * Portfolio Manager * Integrator / COO * Portfolio Company CEO This is a rare opportunity for graduates who want exposure to real businesses, real numbers, real acquisitions, and real leadership responsibility early in their career. We are not looking for people who just want a title. We are looking for people who want to build the skills to deserve one. **What you will learn** * Sales and revenue growth * Business operations and team management * AI implementation * Private equity and acquisitions * Financial reporting and KPIs * Scaling companies * Leadership development **Who we are looking for** * Ambitious, commercially minded and hard working * Coachable, curious and comfortable with pressure * Strong communicator with a hunger to learn * Genuine interest in business, sales, investing, AI and leadership * Fully fluent in English, written and spoken. This is an essential requirement. * Able to commute to Mullingar Monday to Friday. Own transport or public transport both fine. You do not need to know everything yet. You need to be willing to learn fast, work hard, take ownership, and grow. **Why this is different** Most graduate jobs put you in a narrow role and keep you there. At DG Ventures the right people can build a career across multiple companies and industries. As the group grows and acquires more businesses, more leadership seats open up. The people who perform, lead well, use AI, understand numbers, and execute properly will move quickly. This is not a guaranteed path to CEO. It is a real pathway for the right person to build the skills, experience, and track record to one day run a company within the DG Ventures portfolio. If you want a safe, slow, normal graduate job this is not for you. If you want to learn business from the inside, grow fast, and build a career worth talking about, we want to hear from you. **What is in it for you** * Competitive base salary with uncapped commission * Real career progression across multiple companies and industries * Regular personal and professional development training * Hybrid working available after an initial onboarding period * Travel opportunities for top performers to Dubai, Cape Town, and Asia Hit apply now. We will be in touch within 72 hours. DG Ventures | Kilroys House, Patrick St, Mullingar, Co. Westmeath Job Type: Full-time Pay: €30,000.00-€50,000.00 per year Ability to commute/relocate: * Mullingar, County Westmeath: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required) Application question(s): * Are you fluent in English, both written and spoken? Education: * Bachelor's (preferred) Work Location: In person

title: Graduate Structural Engineer
description: **Join Our Team** **PLEASE NOTE THIS POSITION IS TO START IN SEPTEMBER 2027** With 29 locations, Cundall’s global presence allows our structural engineers to be involved in many challenging and exciting building projects. Working across a variety of industry sectors, our Structures teams are renowned for producing innovative and award-winning sustainable engineering solutions throughout the lifecycle of any building project. To build on our great work so far, we are looking for graduates who want to create, improve and protect the environment in which we live and provide the facilities for day-to-day life, transport and industry to function effectively. The Structural engineering teams provide industry-leading expertise – and offer a pro-active and collaborative approach to skill development, and professional excellence. Join us and you could be a part of a team who built a state-of-the-art faculty of medical sciences for a university campus, Eton College Sports and Aquatic Centre , The All England Lawn Tennis Club (AELTC’s) Somerset Road project or King's College School, Wimbledon - new music school . **The Role You'll Play** In this graduate role, you’ll join our Structural Engineering team to work on the design of some of the most exciting construction design projects in Ireland and worldwide. Working closely with colleagues across our multi-disciplinary practice, you’ll provide specialist consultancy input on projects across a wide range of sectors. Join us as a Graduate Structural Engineer and you’ll work with and be guided by a team of expert engineers to carry out conceptual as well as detailed structural engineering design and analysis, using your maths, science, and problem-solving skills to design inspirational and sustainable structures and more. This role will require you to use your knowledge and expertise to define and translate clients’ needs into designs for buildings, infrastructure, facilities, and services with sustainability at the forefront of the design. You’ll have the opportunity over time to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop, and with accredited professional development programmes from the IStructE or ICE, you’ll be supported towards Chartership. **The Skills You'll Bring** * On target to achieve at least a 2:2 degree. * Desirable if accredited with or on course to achieve a BEng/MEng degree level (or equivalent) in Structural Engineering or Civil Engineering. * You’ll have a keen interest in structural design and analysis for the built environment, and crucially - have a passion for creative and intuitive design. * Possessing a desire for personal and professional development, you’ll have the proven ability to work effectively as part of a team. * Digital engineering is a big focus at Cundall, so ideally, you’ll have an understanding of Parametric Modelling Techniques (Grasshopper or Dynamo), or at least one modern programming language (e.g. Python, C#, VB). * You are organised and methodical in your approach to managing your tasks and priorities, striving to meet deadlines. * Collaborative in nature, you’ll be able to empathise with your clients’ needs and utilise excellent communication skills, both in writing and verbally, with internal and external stakeholders. You’re used to using your initiative to overcome challenges and have a positive, can-do attitude. **What’s in it for you?** We offer a competitive starting salary which grows as you develop, as well as many training and development opportunities to make sure you keep progressing. Aside from this, those who successfully join our graduate scheme also enjoy: * A one-off joining bonus of € 1,500, payable during your first week of employment. * A € 2,000 bonus on gaining chartered status with a relevant professional body. * 22 days' holiday per annum (plus statutory holidays). * A flexible benefits package which enables you to select additional benefits to suit your personal circumstances. Graduate Brochure **Job Description** Must have right to work in Ireland, we do not provide sponsorship for this role. **We know that to be the best at what we do we need a diverse workforce underpinned by an inclusive culture. Creating environments where everyone can find joy doing their best work is also great for everyone. That’s why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.**

title: Graduate Traffic Engineer (Dublin)
description: At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. Your impact Join the Jacobs Graduate Development Program (GDP) and help shape better environments, communities and societies. Bring your passion, creativity and ambition — and together, we’ll create lasting change. **What You’ll Get** Our two‑year Graduate Development Program is designed to accelerate your growth as you begin your Jacobs career. Through blended learning, mentoring, progress reviews and networking, you’ll build capability across four key areas human skills, consulting skills, championing our strategy, and developing your personal passions. You’ll tailor your learning journey to your interests, career goals and technical strengths — creating a graduate experience that’s uniquely yours. Much of your development will come through real project work, supported by your manager and mentor to ensure you gain the experiences that matter most. The Graduate Development Program isn’t just a steppingstone — it’s a launchpad. You’ll gain the tools, exposure and support to unlock your potential, working on meaningful projects and collaborating with industry leaders to deliver solutions to complex challenges. **About The Opportunity** The Graduate Traffic Engineers will join our Transport Planning and Mobility Solutions team which is part of our Cities & Places and Major Programmes business unit. We help create thriving places across different scales from regions to cities, neighbourhoods to sites, by offering an integrated design approach. Our business unit brings together transport planners, engineers, architects, designers, surveyors, urban designers and project managers to provide collaborative and coordinated value design solutions for our clients both nationally and internationally. Our team skillsets cover the full remit of transport planning across all modes; from high level policy and strategy advice through transport modelling/appraisal to active travel, streets design, traffic engineering and junction design. We are interested in hearing from candidates who are keen to develop a rounded set of skills, as well as those who have more specialised interests including but not limited to traffic engineering, active travel scheme design and transformational placemaking, transport decarbonisation, traffic management solutions or public transport schemes for example. You will have the support of a mentor, our management team and experts who will help guide your progress. You will also be given the opportunity to pursue relevant business and technical training to support your career development, as well as room to grow your network and knowledge base to create innovative solutions. We are looking for aspirational Graduate Traffic Engineers to join our teams in the UK and Ireland. This opportunity is for a role in our Dublin office. The start date for this position is **September 2027.** Here's what you'll need * Be working towards a relevant Degree or Master’s level qualification in Transport Planning, Civil Engineering, Urban Planning, Mathematics/Statistics, Physics, Natural Sciences or Data/Computer Science. * Hold a keen interest in traffic engineering topics, such as healthy streets, walking, cycling and public transport planning, transport policy/strategy, transport modelling/appraisal, junction improvement, placemaking etc * A flexible, proactive mindset and motivation to drive your career forward * Adaptability and enthusiasm for learning * Permanent right to work in Ireland **Selection Process** * Apply Online * Solo Video Assessment * Interview Apply before **12 October 2026** to be considered in the first assessment window. Applications may still be accepted afterwards, but roles may be filled during the initial window. For further information, please see our brochure - https//jacobs-global.foleon.com/brochures/early-careers/ ; #EarlyCareersIreland #GraduateIreland #GraduateJob2027 #GraduateCareersIreland #GraduaterecruitmentIreland #GraduateJobsIreland #GraduateopportunitiesIreland Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging. We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees. With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits, and opportunities, from well-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture, and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs. We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of different perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. We are committed to building vibrant communities within Jacobs, including through our Jacobs Employee Networks, Communities of Practice and our Find Your Community initiatives, allowing every employee to find connection, purpose, and belonging. Find out more about our Jacobs Employee Networks here. Jacobs partners with VERCIDA to help us attract and retain talent from a wide range of backgrounds. For greater online accessibility please visit https//www.vercida.com/uk/employers/jacobs to view and access our roles. As a disability confident employer, we will interview disabled candidates who best meet the criteria. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role. We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Graduate/Junior Electrical Estimator
description: When you join KPMG Ireland, you are joining a community of over 4,200 employees who collectively work together, both in person and virtually, to achieve their full potential. We are known as an organisation who want you to come as you are and do work that truly matters. Joining KPMG Ireland is an opportunity to enhance your career, not only in the work that you enjoy doing, but equally through the global connections that you make, the lifelong learning that you can accomplish and the chance to make your mark. **Are you our next Graduate/Junior Electrical Estimator – Mission Critical Team?** **Location: Dublin or Cork, as part of our hybrid working model.** **Grade: Assistant** **Contract type: Permanent** **A Snapshot Of Your Peer Group** * A degree, diploma or trade-based qualification in Electrical Engineering, Building Services, Quantity Surveying or a related discipline. * Up to approximately 2 years of relevant estimating, quantity surveying, engineering, contracting or construction experience. Applications from new graduates are welcome. * An interest in estimating and cost management, with strong numerical and analytical skills. * Confident using Microsoft Excel and able to learn estimating, take-off and cost management software. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail and a collaborative approach. * Experience in data centres, semiconductor facilities or another mission-critical environment would be beneficial but is not essential. **Your responsibilities and achievements will evolve as you enhance your career with us. Here is what you can initially expect:** You Will Build Your Technical And Commercial Estimating Capability While Supporting Live Assignments Under The Guidance Of Experienced Estimators And Cost Managers. You Can Initially Expect To * Assist with measurement and quantity take-offs from electrical single-line diagrams, layouts, specifications, equipment schedules and design information. * Support the preparation of feasibility estimates, elemental cost plans, pre-tender estimates and tender analyses. * Help develop bills of quantities, pricing schedules, scope matrices and estimate back-up. * Obtain, organise and compare quotations from the electrical subcontractor and supplier markets. * Maintain cost databases, benchmark information and project records. * Check calculations, assumptions, quantities and pricing inputs before issue. * Support value engineering, option appraisal and cost-risk reviews. * Work with CSA, mechanical and electrical colleagues to identify scope interfaces and gaps. * Attend design and commercial meetings, prepare clear notes and follow through on agreed actions. * Develop an understanding of electrical building services including HV/LV distribution, transformers, switchgear, generators, UPS, busbar, power distribution, lighting, containment, earthing, controls and associated systems. * Contribute to consistent, high-quality client deliverables and meet agreed deadlines. **Your Team** You will join KPMG Ireland's Construction Advisory practice, working within our growing Mission Critical team. The team provides cost management, estimating, commercial advisory, procurement and project controls support across complex capital programmes. You will work alongside CSA, mechanical and electrical specialists, giving you exposure to integrated project delivery from early feasibility and design development through procurement, construction and final account. **Discover How KPMG Can Enrich Your Life Beyond Your Career** **Benefits Tailored For You** At KPMG, we understand that life is multifaceted. That’s why we offer a flexible benefits package designed to support your unique lifestyle. Our benefits include: * Discounted Health Insurance: Prioritise your well-being with our health insurance options. * Additional Annual Leave: Purchase extra leave to spend more time with friends and family or to travel. * Enhanced Family Leave: Enjoy more time with your family with our generous leave options. * Emergency Childcare Cover: For times when your regular childcare plans fall through * Social Events: Connect and network with colleagues through our engaging social events. * Early Finish Fridays: Start your weekends early on bank holidays and during the summer. * Relocation Assistance: Smooth your transition if you’re moving to Ireland. * Learning & Development: Access our extensive supports, including LinkedIn Learning, to grow your skills. We also offer a variety of flexible working options to help you balance your professional and personal life. **Career Progression with Continuous Support** From the moment you join KPMG, you’ll receive dedicated support from your performance manager to enhance your skills. Our award-winning Business School provides continuous learning opportunities to deepen your expertise. We stand out as the only Big Four firm to announce promotions four times a year, offering you frequent opportunities for career advancement. **Commitment to Inclusion & Diversity** Inclusion, diversity, and equity are at the heart of KPMG. We celebrate diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we’re committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable environment at every level. Our goal is to attract and retain the best talent by building a culture where everyone can achieve their potential. Learn more about our commitment here - https://kpmg.com/ie/en/home/about/inclusion-diversity-equity.html **Ready to Join Us?** If you meet most of the criteria, we encourage you to apply by submitting your CV. KPMG is an equal opportunities employer, welcoming applications from people of all backgrounds. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process if needed. Necessary arrangements can be made at interview stage to accommodate the needs of candidates with disabilities. For any specific queries about the role, please contact Niamh McRory For a glimpse into life at KPMG, follow #ExperienceKPMG on LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and X. **Please note that agency assistance is not required for this position.** By clicking apply to this role your application will not only be considered for this position, but your details will be stored on our database and may be considered for similar future positions that may arise. This means that the personal data contained in your application and provided to KPMG as part of the application process may be retained by us for up to 18 months from the date of your application and you hereby agree to that. If you do not wish your details to be stored on our recruitment database, please email careers@kpmg.ie stating this and we will ensure that such information is not stored other than for the purposes of this application.

title: Group Accountant
description: Barden is delighted to partner with a well-established international group as they look to hire a Group Financial Accountant. This is a permanent role in a high-calibre group finance function, offering real visibility with Board and senior management. You will own the monthly management accounts for a number of group entities, support the consolidation and annual reporting cycle, and help the team improve how it reports. It is a broad role with plenty of exposure across a multi-country business. **ABOUT THE ROLE** * Prepare monthly management accounts and reporting packs for a number of group entities. * Analyse variances and manage trial balances, balance sheet reconciliations, and intercompany reconciliations. * Produce the monthly flash results and weekly sales analysis. * Support budgets, quarterly forecasts, and cash-flow monitoring. * Assist with interim results, final results, and the annual report. * Work with business units across several countries and keep improving reporting processes. **ABOUT THE PERSON** * Qualified accountant (ACA) with a strong academic background. * Minimum 1 year PQE within industry. * Advanced Excel, including pivots, with Power BI a bonus. * Exposure to ERP and consolidation systems is an advantage. * Commercial, detail-focused, and comfortable working to tight deadlines. **OTHER DETAILS** * Permanent role. * Hybrid working model. * Competitive package including bonus and benefits. Interested? Please apply through the link or contact **Jack O Regan (jack.oregan@barden.ie)** for a confidential conversation.

title: HR Graduate
description: At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One. As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other. We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation. We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do. **Job Description** ------------------- The Human Resources team supports employees throughout their career with U.S. Bank, from recruitment and onboarding through to learning, & development, talent, employee relations, total rewards, organisational change and HR risk. Our goal is to create an environment where our people and our business can thrive. Based in Cherrywood, Dublin you will join our HR team on a 18 month Graduate Programme designed to give you broad exposure to Human Resources, with a particular focus on project and programme management. You will work alongside HR colleagues and business stakeholders, supporting projects that help deliver our People strategy and wider business priorities. Through a combination of hands-on experience, structured development and exposure to different areas of HR, you will build both your HR knowledge and project management capability. **What you'll learn and experience** During the programme, you will have the opportunity to: * Support the planning and delivery of HR projects and programmes from initiation through to implementation. * Develop project plans, track milestones, actions, risks and dependencies. * Coordinate meetings, workshops and project activities involving colleagues across HR and the wider business. * Gather and analyse people data to help measure progress and support decision-making. * Prepare project updates, presentations and communications for a range of stakeholders. * Support change management and communications activities to help embed new HR initiatives. * Build relationships with stakeholders across different HR functions and business areas. * Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and the employee experience. * Take increasing ownership of project activities as your knowledge, confidence and experience develop. * Complete a CIPD qualification as part of the programme, supporting your professional development and building your knowledge of HR best practice. **What we're looking for** We're looking for someone who is curious about people, business and how projects can drive change. You don't need to start the programme as an HR or project management expert. We'll support you in developing those skills. You'll ideally bring: * An degree/masters in HR, Business/Management, Psychology or another relevant discipline. * A strong interest in developing a career in Human Resources and project management. * Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Confidence working with data and presenting information clearly. * A collaborative approach and an interest in working with different teams and stakeholders. * Curiosity, initiative and a willingness to learn. * Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, data analysis * Available to start on the 1 Feb 2027 **What you'll gain** By the end of the programme, you'll have developed practical experience of delivering HR projects, managing stakeholders, using data to inform decisions and supporting organisational change, alongside a broad understanding of how different HR functions work together to deliver a People strategy. **Few more details** * 18 month fixed term contract * Location: Cherrywood. The role offers a hybrid / flexible schedule, which means there's an in-office expectation of 3 or more days per week and the flexibility to work outside the office location for the other days. * Ideally graduated in 2025 or 2026 with 1 year or less experience. * This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have the right to work in Ireland. **Accessibility** We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need adjustments at any stage of the application or hiring process, please contact your recruiter for guidance and support. **Total Rewards** U.S. Bank is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices in line with local regulatory and legal requirements. Our total rewards approach is designed to attract, retain, and support top talent while ensuring equal pay for work of equal value. We offer a market-competitive compensation package that includes: * **Clearly defined salary ranges** aligned with industry benchmarks and internal equity standards. * **Performance-based incentives** for eligible employees (as defined by relevant plan rules), awarded through transparent, objective criteria that recognize both individual and company performance. * **Inclusive equitable benefits** that are accessible to all employees and focused around our 3 main pillars of financial wellbeing, health & wellness). * **Continuous development opportunities** including training, education support, and career progression pathways based on inclusive and transparent criteria. * **Employee recognition programs** that celebrate achievements and milestones for all. We regularly review our compensation and benefits to ensure they remain competitive, inclusive, and responsive to employee needs and market trends. Further details of the compensation package will be provided upon application. We encourage candidates to explore the full value of our offer, including monetary and non-monetary benefits, at Employee benefits and development | U.S. Bank | Elavon. **Closing Date** Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants. We aim to provide timely updates throughout the process and encourage early applications to ensure consideration.

title: Infrastructure & Engineering Graduate Pathways
description: **Job Description** As a daa Infrastructure Graduate, you will help deliver the infrastructure that keeps Ireland connected to the world. From expanding airfields and terminals to delivering major civil engineering and sustainability projects, you will contribute to some of Ireland's most significant infrastructure developments across Dublin and Cork Airports. Working in a live operational environment, you will gain exposure to complex projects that support future growth, enhance connectivity, and improve the passenger experience. Graduates will join the Early Careers Community, a network of interns, apprentices, and second-year graduates, offering opportunities to learn, collaborate, and build professional connections across the business. Over this two-year fixed-term contract, you'll work within our Infrastructure team, contributing to major projects across Dublin and Cork Airports, including airfield and terminal expansions, civil engineering works, transport infrastructure, and sustainability initiatives. Whether you are contributing to airfield developments, terminal expansions, transport infrastructure, or sustainability initiatives, you will play a meaningful role in projects that have a lasting impact. If you are passionate about engineering, innovation, and creating infrastructure that connects people and businesses around the world, the daa Infrastructure Graduate role offers the perfect foundation for an exciting and rewarding career. **Responsibilities** As a daa Infrastructure Graduate, you will continue to build expertise within your specialism, gaining hands-on experience in areas which may include project delivery, strategy, advisory services, contracts, programme controls, governance, health and safety, quality assurance, and technical services. Working in a live operational aviation environment, you will collaborate with consultants, contractors, and stakeholders across the business, contributing to capital projects that are shaping the future of Ireland's aviation infrastructure. **Areas You May Gain Exposure Includes** * Civil Airfield Development - Contributing to major airfield infrastructure projects, including Ireland's first airport runway underpass, while developing your technical and problem-solving skills on complex engineering challenges. * Piers & Terminal Development - Supporting the design and delivery of terminal and pier developments that enhance capacity and create a world-class passenger experience. * Access & Connectivity Improvements - Working alongside Planning and Strategy teams on projects that improve airport accessibility, strengthen connectivity, and support long-term growth. * Sustainability & Safety - Helping ensure safety and sustainability are embedded in every stage of infrastructure development, supporting daa's environmental ambitions and future-ready infrastructure goals. **Qualifications** **Do you have what it takes?** **Role** We’re looking for ambitious graduates ready to shape the future of infrastructure. To succeed in these entry level graduate roles, you should: * Hold (or be expecting) a 2.1 degree or higher in Civil/Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Quantity Surveying, or a related Construction discipline. * Demonstrate a strong understanding of engineering, construction, or infrastructure principles gained through your studies or project work. * Bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate information and make sound decisions. * Be naturally curious and motivated, with a desire to learn, develop, and take on new challenges. * Demonstrate adaptability, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic and evolving environments. * Show an innovative mindset, seeking opportunities to improve processes, challenge conventional thinking, and solve problems creatively. * Exhibit learning agility, embracing feedback, and continuously developing new skills and capabilities. * Be strong collaborators, building effective relationships and working successfully across teams and stakeholders to achieve shared goals. * Align with daa's values and purpose, sharing our commitment to enabling business, connecting lives, and building a sustainable future. **What We Are Offering You?** As a daa Infrastructure Graduate, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your growth, reward your impact, and help you thrive - professionally and personally. From global exposure to wellbeing perks, this programme is your launchpad to a standout career in aviation infrastructure. **Programme Benefits Include** * Competitive salary with a performance-related bonus to reward your impact * A structured development pathway, including a 12-week Engineers Ireland-accredited Airport Planning & Design course, alongside expert-led knowledge-sharing sessions throughout the year. * Exposure to major infrastructure and capital projects, giving you the opportunity to contribute to projects of varying scale, complexity, and strategic importance. * Hands-on experience with industry-leading technologies, including BIM, GIS and cloud-based project delivery platforms used across large-scale infrastructure programmes. * The opportunity to build technical expertise in civil and construction engineering, project planning, design coordination, and site delivery. * A strong foundation for professional accreditation, supported by experienced mentors, continuous learning opportunities, and real-world project experience. #IND

title: Junior Data Engineer
description: **Description** Junior Data Engineer **About Designer Group** Designer Group is a leading international mechanical & electrical provider specialising in turnkey packages for the design, supply, and installation of M&E services. This investment has produced an innovative and passionate team that delivers projects for our clients safely, efficiently and to the highest standards in the industry. Our approach to everything we do is underpinned by our Values of: * Safe * Trust * Respect * Challenge * Deliver Role Purpose Designer Group is seeking a Junior Data Engineer to join our Technology team. This is an excellent opportunity for a graduate or early-career professional to develop their skills within a growing data and digital function. Working closely with the Data Engineering Lead and stakeholders across the business, the successful candidate will support the development and optimisation of Designer Group's data platform, helping transform business requirements into reliable data products. The role will involve data engineering, reporting, data quality improvement, and business intelligence development using Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. Key Responsibilities Business Engagement & Requirements Gathering * Collaborate with stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Operations, HR, BIM and Project teams to understand reporting and analytics requirements. * Assist in translating business requirements into clear data and reporting specifications. * Support prioritisation of reporting and data requests. * Provide guidance and support to users adopting dashboards and self-service reporting solutions. * Maintain regular communication with stakeholders regarding progress and delivery timelines. Data Engineering * Develop and maintain data pipelines within Microsoft Fabric. * Support the design and maintenance of data lakehouse and warehouse solutions. * Write and maintain SQL and Python/PySpark code for data ingestion and transformation. * Follow established standards relating to testing, documentation, security, version control and deployment. * Participate in peer reviews and code review processes. Platform Monitoring & Support * Monitor pipeline execution, scheduled refreshes and platform performance. * Investigate, troubleshoot and resolve issues or escalate where appropriate. * Create and maintain operational documentation and runbooks. * Assist with monitoring Microsoft Fabric capacity utilisation and workload performance. * Maintain alerts and monitoring processes for data platform operations. Power BI Development & Reporting * Design, develop and enhance Power BI reports, dashboards and semantic models. * Develop DAX measures and apply best-practice data modelling techniques. * Manage report publication, workspace administration, refresh schedules and security controls. * Gather user feedback to improve reporting solutions and user experience. * Maintain the report catalogue and support the full report lifecycle from request through to retirement. Team Collaboration * Work collaboratively with Technology, IT, Enterprise Applications and BIM teams. * Ensure compliance with GDPR, Information Security and AI governance requirements. * Actively participate in training, mentoring and continuous professional development opportunities. **Essential** Skills, Knowledge & Experience * Third-level qualification in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience using Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard and report development. * Good working knowledge of SQL. * Working knowledge of Python, including experience with PySpark. * Understanding of ETL/ELT processes and data engineering principles. * Understanding of data quality management and data modelling concepts. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities. * Strong attention to detail and a structured, methodical approach to work. Desirable * Experience with Microsoft Fabric including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Notebooks and Fabric Pipelines. * Experience with Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics or Databricks. * Microsoft certifications such as PL-300, DP-600 or DP-700. * Familiarity with Git, Azure DevOps or similar version control tools. * Experience working with ERP, CRM, HR or Project Management systems. * Understanding of data governance, data catalogues and modern data management practices. * Experience within construction, engineering, infrastructure or project-based organisations. Personal Attributes * Curious and motivated to understand business processes and how data can drive better decision-making. * Collaborative and approachable, with the ability to build strong working relationships. * Demonstrates ownership, accountability and a proactive attitude. * Strong organisational and time management skills. * Eager to learn and develop professionally. * Positive, adaptable and solution-focused mindset. **Qualifications** Essential * Degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics or a related discipline. Desirable * Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300). * Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600). * Microsoft Certified: Data Engineering on Microsoft Fabric (DP-700). Why Join Designer Group? * Join a leading international engineering contractor delivering complex projects across multiple sectors. * Gain hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and modern cloud-based data platforms. * Receive mentoring and support from experienced data professionals. * Be part of a growing Technology team driving digital transformation across the organisation. * Access continuous professional development and career progression opportunities within a dynamic and expanding business.

title: Junior Mechanical Estimator

You will work alongside CSA, mechanical and electrical specialists, giving you exposure to integrated project delivery from early feasibility and design development through procurement, construction and final account. **Discover How KPMG Can Enrich Your Life Beyond Your Career** **Benefits Tailored For You** At KPMG, we understand that life is multifaceted. We stand out as the only Big Four firm to announce promotions four times a year, offering you frequent opportunities for career advancement. **Commitment to Inclusion & Diversity** Inclusion, diversity, and equity are at the heart of KPMG. Our goal is to attract and retain the best talent by building a culture where everyone can achieve their potential. Learn more about our commitment here - https://kpmg.com/ie/en/home/about/inclusion-diversity-equity.html **Ready to Join Us?** If you meet most of the criteria, we encourage you to apply by submitting your CV. For any specific queries about the role, please contact Niamh McRory For a glimpse into life at KPMG, follow #ExperienceKPMG on LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and X. **Please note that agency assistance is not required for this position.** By clicking apply to this role your application will not only be considered for this position, but your details will be stored on our database and may be considered for similar future positions that may arise. title: Listed Derivatives Processing Analyst
description: **Overview** As a Derivatives Processing Analyst on the Trading Operations team, you will be responsible for processing and crossing Susquehanna’s pre-agreed options block trades on European derivative exchanges. description: **Description** Fascinated by the mechanics behind automated systems? Want to master both electrical and mechanical engineering while working with cutting-edge technology? Our European Engineering team is fundamental to our operations - they keep vital machinery running around the clock. As an OEM Engineering Technician Apprentice, you'll help maintain a wide range of equipment while upholding Health and Safety best practice, keeping your colleagues safe, preventing downtime, and improving the availability and quality of our equipment. You'll thrive here if you stay calm when things go wrong and get a real kick out of fixing them. You're hands-on, curious about how machines work, and you understand that keeping production moving is what it's all about. And you don't need to be a qualified engineer to start - what matters most is a practical, problem-solving mindset and a hunger to learn. **A Day In The Life Can Involve** * Carrying out proactive and preventative maintenance * Carrying out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse * Using the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness * Making modifications and upgrades to existing equipment * Upholding health and safety policies and practices * Working on continuous improvement projects, and suggesting long-term improvements Throughout your apprenticeship, you'll build a broad, in-demand engineering skillset, including: * Fault diagnosis and preventative maintenance * Mechanical device maintenance, and fluid power systems assembly and testing * Electrical equipment wiring and testing * Hydraulics and pneumatics * Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) operations * CAD design and 3D printing Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship, you'll learn by doing, putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development opportunities, and challenging, rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights. If you're a curious learner eager to grow, this is your chance to unlock your full potential and build the future you envision. Throughout the apprenticeship you'll work towards an NFQ Level 6 Advanced Certificate in OEM Engineering, combining practical, on-the-job experience with industry-recognised study. The first 16 weeks of each year will be full-time residential (classroom training) at one of our training providers' facilities. As a result, you may be required to travel to the accommodation on a Sunday and work away from home until Friday each week during term time (costs supported by Amazon), combined with short periods working at one of our Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, or Delivery Stations. In subsequent years, you'll undertake on-the-job training in a Fulfilment Centre while concurrently completing your academic training, learning directly from experienced technicians and engineers and gaining exposure to real engineering projects. Alongside invaluable experience, you'll gain a number of externally recognised qualifications. This role supports our 24/7 operation, so you'll work shifts covering days, nights and weekends - patterns that reflect the real-world schedules of the engineers who keep Amazon operating around the clock. You'll join a diverse and passionate team of engineers dedicated to driving results and pushing creative boundaries. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups - including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities - foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. These groups provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve. We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a well-rounded professional. Join us and be part of the team that keeps Amazon moving. Apply now and shape the future of technology with us. As part of the recruitment and enrolment process for this apprenticeship, candidates must provide proof of all required qualifications. Original certificates or certified copies must be submitted - this is a mandatory requirement to secure the position. The deadline for providing qualification certificates for the RME Mechatronics programme is 16 July 2027. Applications without verified qualifications by this date will automatically be unsuccessful, and failure to provide proof by the deadline will result in the withdrawal of any conditional offer, meaning you will not be able to commence the programme. Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility, and offers may be withdrawn for applicants who do not meet the funding criteria. **Basic Qualifications** * To qualify for this programme, you must: * Be 18 years or over before the start date (September 2027) * Have the right to live and work in Ireland at the point of enrolment (June 2027). If you are on a visa, this must enable you to legally work and reside in Ireland for the entire duration of the programme from enrolment. * Have lived in Ireland or in the European Economic Area (EEA) for the last 3 years prior to the start date * Not be registered to study on a Irish government funded course ending August 2027 or later * Be prepared to travel for external/mandatory training as part of the apprenticeship * You will have obtained a Leaving Certificate with five 06 or higher grades which must include Mathematics or Leaving Certificate Applied with five passes plus Level 5 Mathematics and one year industry experience OR * Have successfully completed an approved pre-apprenticeship training course in an engineering discipline and demonstrate a proficiency in Mathematics similar to 06 in Leaving Certificate OR * A full award placed at Level 5 on the National Framework of Qualifications (EQF 4) which includes proficiency in Mathematics similar to 06 in Leaving Certificate OR * In the case where an applicant is 23 years or over (or employed in the OEM sector for 3 years) and does not meet the educational requirements specified above, they may apply through the Recognised Prior Learning (RPL) process. ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS will need to be met * Please note, if you have received educational qualifications outside of Ireland then we will require a Statement of Comparability to confirm your eligibility for the scheme. Please ensure you obtain one during the application process, through UK ENIC: https://www.enic.org.uk/ * Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility and offers are subject to funding approval * PLEASE NOTE: This position is a 36 month fixed-term contract. You must NOT already have a qualification in a similar subject at the same or higher level than this apprenticeship. * This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has some or little knowledge/experience of the occupation **Preferred Qualifications** * A genuine interest in engineering, machines, and how automated systems work * A practical, hands-on approach and enjoyment of taking things apart to understand and fix them * Great problem-solving skills and the ability to stay calm and methodical when things go wrong * Good attention to detail and an awareness of health and safety * An eagerness to learn, take on new challenges, and grow professionally * Willing and able to work shifts, including days, nights and weekends * Able to arrange reliable travel to and from training sites, some of which aren't served by public transport other than taxi (access to a car can help but isn't essential) Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Security Engineer, New Grad
description: Who we are: About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Stripe offers an interesting middle ground between joining a small startup and going to work for a multinational company. We have systems and processes optimized for early-career professionals. You will be in an environment that prizes rigor, discipline, and reliability—from our products, from our ways of working, and from our colleagues. You will learn how the best teams put together extremely reliable systems, and you will be responsible for operating these systems, with adequate backup when things get tough. The Security organization is dedicated to building and maintaining a secure financial infrastructure platform. By joining this team, you will be on the front lines, engineering solutions that protect the sensitive data and systems underpinning a huge portion of the world's economy. You will contribute to core security functions like threat detection and rapid incident response, building and scaling the platforms that manage vulnerabilities, and proactively performing offensive security assessments to identify weaknesses before they can be exploited. This is a chance to apply software engineering principles and new technologies such as AI to solve complex, high-stakes security challenges, ultimately ensuring that Stripe's mission to increase the GDP of the internet is achieved securely. What you’ll do As a Security Engineer New Grad you will have the opportunity to work across various security disciplines and own projects from start to finish. Your work will focus on securing Stripe's complex environment by applying software engineering principles to security challenges. \* You will learn and apply the principles of secure-by-default design by working closely with product and infrastructure engineering teams. * You'll develop a foundational understanding of various security domains, such as threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, or offensive security. * You'll learn to act as a security subject matter expert, tailoring answers to both engineers and non-engineers. * You'll contribute to the development of internal tools and automation to scale security efforts across Stripe. * You will participate in threat modeling discussions, learning to balance security requirements with product advancement and user experience. Responsibilities \* Work on cross-functional projects, directly collaborating with other engineers * Give meaningful feedback on code reviews and technical designs * Contribute to our overall security posture by continuously improving security processes, tooling, and defenses. * Develop a deep understanding of Stripe’s security primitives, frameworks, and invariants. * Provide actionable insights to help identify, prevent, detect, and respond to anomalous or potentially malicious activity. Who you are: We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements \* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Computer Science or related field (graduating by Summer 2026) * Some experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, Python, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present * Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting) * Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor and subject matter experts * Aptitude to think like an attacker and reason through different approaches to reducing security risk. Preferred qualifications \* Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems * Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases * Prior experience or course work in cyber security, digital forensics, or incident response (e.g., through log analysis or capture-the-flag events). * Familiarity with foundational security concepts such as the OWASP Top 10 web application vulnerabilities. * Basic knowledge of SQL or experience analyzing medium to large data sets. * Exposure to cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. * An adversarial mindset, understanding the goals, behaviors, and TTPs (tactics, techniques, and procedures) of threat actors. In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €64,000 - €96,000. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends. We look forward to hearing from you. At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. Apply now Please find our EU applicant personal information notice here.

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.* *Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.* **Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams** Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities.
